component.name: NEXORA
component.summary: Private, fast, cross-platform peer-to-peer file sharing

description.p: NEXORA is a production-grade, private cross-platform peer-to-peer file sharing application built with Flutter and Rust. It enables seamless high-speed transfers across Android, Windows, and Linux over your local area network without requiring third-party cloud servers or internet access.

ul.li: Zero-configuration peer discovery via mDNS and UDP multicast.
End-to-end authenticated pairing and explicit receiver transfer approvals.
Length-prefixed binary streaming with SHA-256 chunk validation.
Recursive folder transfer preserving directory hierarchy with path traversal defenses.
Resumable transfers and automatic exponential backoff retry.

description.p: Production release with optimized Android split APKs, instant large-file initiation, streaming SHA-256 verification, and branded Windows installer.
Initial production release of NEXORA supporting Android, Windows, and Linux.
